capabilities: Insert a music block into new daily notes named YYYY-MM-DD
Backfill missing music blocks into existing daily notes on demand
Remove music blocks from notes dated before a chosen cutoff date
Serve a built-in collection of 366 works mapped to fixed calendar dates
disambiguation: Not a music player; it only writes a text block with a YouTube link into daily notes.
extras: Requires the Daily Notes date format YYYY-MM-DD since matching is by filename; includes a Ko-fi support link; the collection derives from an external recommendation list and no analytics or network requests run in the background.
motivation: The author wants to "Bring a little classical music to your daily notes."
problem: Obsidian daily notes contain no daily listening suggestion, so users have no built-in way to get a rotating music selection in each day's note.
summary: Daily-notes companion that inserts a fixed daily classical music pick with title, composer, and YouTube link into notes named YYYY-MM-DD.
